alloy.preparation: ORNL 500-g alloy arc-melted in a water-cooled Cu crucible under argon, remelted six times, drop-cast in a Cu mold; hot-forged 50% at 1000°C, hot-rolled 50% at 800°C, and warm-rolled 70% at 650°C to 0.75 mm. Annealed in air at 850°C for 1 h for recrystallization, then 7 days at 500°C for ordering, followed by air cooling. Mounted in Maraglas 655 epoxy cured 80°C for 24 h; ground with 600-grit SiC. Epoxy/specimen interface coated with Amercoat 90, exposing 1 cm²; cured 70°C for 10 h. Before testing, hand-polished with 9-µm diamond paste to remove curing oxide; interface seal lightly abraded without damage.

test_solution.preparation: Distilled water acidified to pH 4 with H2SO4, containing NaCl; continuously sparged with oxygen for aerated polarization.

test_method.procedure_description: Noncrevice specimen configuration; EG&G 273 potentiostat. Stabilize at OCP in oxygen-sparged solution until potential change <1 mV/min. Scan anodically from OCP to a current density of 10⁻³ A/cm², reverse and continue until protection potential Ep is identified or no hysteresis develops. Saturated-KCl Ag/AgCl reference; authors report all values on the SHE scale. No numerical electrolyte test temperature is stated.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Forward-scan breakdown potential Eb used as resistance to initiation of localized/pitting corrosion; reverse-scan protection potential Ep is distinct.

experiments.result_note: Graphical breakdown potential Eb used by the paper as resistance to initiation of localized/pitting corrosion; not a reverse-scan protection potential. Materials/methods specify 850°C recrystallization; Figure 3 caption prints 859°C. The methods schedule is retained with that source discrepancy explicit.

The paragraph on p.8 states that the iron aluminides, rather than all three comparison materials, received B2 treatment. The type 304L anchor remains unchanged; no commercial composition is inferred.
experiments.failure_notes: Registry obs_013 lists B2 heat treatment for type 304L, but the source scopes B2 treatment to the iron aluminides. The stainless-steel treatment cannot be recovered; B2 is not assigned to this specimen.
